task: Desktop CLI supervisor MVP resource review

resource_risks.description: CLI health checks spawn child processes and could hang or remain running.
resource_risks.mitigation: The backend runs only allowlisted commands with `--version`, closes stdin, applies a 2500 ms timeout, kills the child on timeout, and records missing commands as capability_missing.

resource_risks.description: Version commands can still emit unexpected stdout or stderr.
resource_risks.mitigation: stdout and stderr readers drain the process streams and retain only up to MAX_HEALTH_OUTPUT_BYTES for the report.

resource_risks.description: The Monitor UI can be loaded outside Tauri, where desktop commands are unavailable.
resource_risks.mitigation: The UI checks for `window.__TAURI__.core.invoke` before calling backend commands and shows an unavailable fallback if no bridge exists.

lifecycle_checks.resource: child process for CLI version health check
lifecycle_checks.create_path: run_bounded_command spawns an allowlisted executable with version_args and stdin null
lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: child exits normally or is killed after timeout; stdout/stderr reader threads are joined

measurement_checks.metric: retained stdout/stderr bytes per health check
measurement_checks.threshold: MAX_HEALTH_OUTPUT_BYTES is 20000 bytes per stream reader retention path
Requires Rust toolchain and documented installation audit
measurement_checks.rationale: Rust is not installed on this machine, and the task did not authorize dependency or toolchain installation.

notes: Future interactive PTY and long-running CLI lanes need separate process-group, cancellation, and memory measurements.
